harper: starting HelioHealth POC throughput run now. goal: confirm 5k embed qps + 500 gen qps mixed pattern, measure tails and validate burst behavior. i'll drop quick notes.
raul: thanks. what's the exact mix and infra?
harper: mix = 82% embeds (seq=64), 12% short-gen (seq=128 max_gen=48), 6% long-gen (seq=512 max_gen=256). infra: Dedicated 8x A10g-equivalent, models: helio-embed-4b-8bit and helio-gen-13b-4bit, batching: continuous, batch_timeout_ms=10, max_batch_tokens=12288.
sales-jess: customer asked if we can commit p95 embed <100ms at 5k qps and whether burst will "fix" all tail spikes. also asked for HSM/KMS options and evidence for encryption.
eng-ada: loadgen started. early 5m window: sustained qps 4.9k, embed p50=18ms p95=112ms p99=330ms. gen p95=290ms p99=1.05s. notice p95 slightly above target occasionally.
ops-bot: autoscaler: pool util 93% at 6123456850; reserved capacity reached; burst disabled for this test.
harper: paste logs snippet: 
```
[6123456860] id=E401 slot=gpu-3 qlen=11 batch_tks=10000 p95=118ms p99=360ms gpu_util=89% nvlink=75% cache_hit=0.91
[6123456862] id=G87 slot=gpu-7 qlen=2 batch_tks=180 p95=32ms p99=98ms gpu_util=28% nvlink=10% cache_hit=0.99
[6123456871] id=L12 slot=gpu-1 qlen=15 batch_tks=13200 p95=480ms p99=1280ms gpu_util=99% nvlink=94% cache_hit=0.52
```
raul: big p99s line up with long-gen starts and low cache_hit. NVLink saturates on those windows.
eng-ada: hypothesis: long generations evict prefix KVs on hot workers, causing large memcpy and NVLink pressure when a long gen begins. also very large batch_tokens occasionally exceed efficient kernel path -> scheduling jitter.
infra-nate: note: autoscaler blocked by reserved commit. enabling burst for POC will add GPUs temporarily but if root cause is KV churn, we still see tail from single long gens.
sales-jess: customer follow-up: if we enable burst during business hours, will they still see p95 violations? need a clear sentence.
eng-ada: short: burst reduces queueing-related tail by adding capacity, but single-request long-gen cold-cache stalls will still cause occasional high p99s. recommended fix: pinned route for long-gen + prefix_cache tuning + burst.
harper: running targeted A/B tests now: 1) baseline, 2) enable prefix_cache with cache_max_entries=30k, 3) prefix_cache+pin long-gen to warm-route (2 GPU equiv), 4) same as 3 + burst enabled.
harper: loadgen command:
```
./loadgen --target 5000 --burst 7000 --mix "embed:0.82:seq=64,short-gen:0.12:seq=128,max=48,long-gen:0.06:seq=512,max=256" --duration 900 --tag helio-iteration1
```
eng-ada: quick A/B results (condensed):
A baseline: embed p95=114ms p99=330ms, gen p95=290ms p99=1050ms.
B cache-only: embed p95=92ms p99=200ms, gen p95=270ms p99=880ms.
C cache+pin: embed p95=88ms p99=180ms, gen p95=240ms p99=410ms.
D cache+pin+burst: embed p95=86ms p99=170ms, gen p95=230ms p99=220ms.
raul: that's helpful. looks like pinning long-gen had biggest bang, burst reduced residual long-tail by adding capacity and lowering queueing amplification.
security-olga: security note for HelioHealth (HIPAA concern): we support encryption in transit and at rest, KMS-based keys, and can offer customer-managed keys in Private. HSM-backed key store available but requires lead time (~3 weeks) and additional contract SOW. SOC2 artifacts available on request.
sales-jess: i'll craft a short customer message: recommend enabling prefix cache + pin long-gen to a warm route and enabling burst windows for peak hours. estimate burst cost and provide security timeline. keep it concise.
ops-bot: cost_estimate: enabling burst for expected 2x30min/day windows -> ~$0.11/min -> estimated ~$66/month (rough).
harper: also noticed slight quality delta when using 4-bit gen quant vs fp16: fluency comparable but some rare tokenization artifacts in long summaries. i'll flag that in notes for product.
eng-ada: next steps: infra create route "long-gen-warm" pinned to 2 GPU equiv, ops enable burst for next validation, we'll run 60m capture with full traces and token-level timings.
infra-nate: creating route now and scheduling burst window for 6123457800.
harper: scheduled. i'll run the 60m and post final p50/p95/p99 + config and slide for sales.
sales-jess: for contract wording propose: "p95 embed latency <=100ms under committed capacity and recommended routing/batching config. With enabled burst autoscale and recommended routing, p95 expected <=100ms for typical traffic; rare long-generation events may exceed tail thresholds and are mitigated by pinned routes or streaming options."
raul: if we need deeper profiling during the 60m, ping me; i'll add memcpy/NVLink traces.
harper: thanks all. posting results after the 60m run. :white_check_mark:
